verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API with curl examples, an official MCP server, and integration guides (Claude, Open WebUI, n8n, Dify, OpenClaw), but there is no mention of official client SDKs (e.g., Python, JS, Go libraries) for programmatic integration. Probe results also show no openapi/spec file or SDK-related docs. missing for 10: official SDK packages/libraries in specific languages, SDK documentation, code samples beyond raw HTTP/curl.
